name: Beach Haven Cafe
blurb: Warm, welcoming site for a beachside cafe in South Australia.

detail.business: Beach Haven Cafe is a beloved beachside cafe in South Australia. They needed a site that captured their relaxed, welcoming atmosphere and made it easy for customers to find menus, hours, and get in touch.
detail.built: Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel. Designed from scratch to reflect the cafe's warm coastal identity with a mobile-first layout.
detail.notable: Every section is purpose-built for the cafe's customers — from menus to a Dog of the Month feature that drives repeat visits and social engagement.

name: Coach Pavle
blurb: High-impact personal brand site for an MMA coach in Canada.

detail.business: Coach Pavle is a professional MMA coach based in the Greater Toronto Area. He needed a site that commanded respect, reflected his coaching philosophy, and converted visitors into serious athletes.
detail.built: Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel. Dark, bold design with a strong typographic hierarchy that matches the intensity of the sport.
detail.notable: The site establishes Coach Pavle's personal brand with zero fluff — every section is designed to build credibility and drive enquiries from athletes ready to commit.

name: Beach Haven Cafe
blurb: Brand identity and logo suite for a beachside cafe in South Australia.

detail.business: Beach Haven Cafe is a beloved beachside cafe in South Australia. We developed a full brand identity suite to capture their relaxed coastal character across all touchpoints.
detail.built: Delivered a complete logo suite including a circular badge logo, wordmark, and alternate colorways for use across print, digital, and merchandise.
detail.notable: Four logo variants — full color, green wordmark, black, and white — give the cafe flexibility across light and dark backgrounds, uniforms, signage, and packaging.

name: The Yale Saloon
blurb: Full site for Vancouver's iconic country nightclub on Granville Street.
mockupBlurb: a country nightclub on Granville Street in Vancouver

detail.business: The Yale Saloon is Vancouver's premier country nightclub at 1300 Granville St. They needed a site that captured the energy of the venue, showcased weekly events, and handled group bookings and job applications.
detail.built: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel. Bold Western-inspired palette with full events calendar, menu, group bookings, and a job application modal.
detail.notable: Includes a live events calendar with per-night ticket CTAs, a Moroccan-style group bookings section, and a built-in resume submission flow for staff recruitment.

name: Dublin Calling
blurb: Multi-location pub and kitchen site serving three venues across Canada.
mockupBlurb: a multi-location pub and kitchen with three venues across Canada

detail.business: Dublin Calling is a party pub and kitchen with three locations in Toronto (Adelaide St and Danforth Ave) and Vancouver (Granville St). One brand, three distinct venues, each needing their own content.
detail.built: Built with Next.js 16 App Router and Tailwind CSS. Single codebase with dynamic location routing so each venue gets its own pages, menus, events, and contact details.
detail.notable: Three fully independent venue experiences under one domain — menus, events, group bookings, and FAQs all managed per location without duplicating the codebase.

name: Cherry Bomb Cafe
blurb: Bohemian-rustic site for a beloved cafe in the Adelaide Hills.
mockupBlurb: a bohemian cafe and private event space in the Adelaide Hills

detail.business: Cherry Bomb Cafe sits at 253 Lobethal Rd in Ashton, South Australia — a Victorian-inspired cafe with a private Moroccan event space and a loyal Hills community following.
detail.built: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS. Rich cherry red and cream palette with apothecary-inspired typography. Pages include menu, gallery, local transport, and the private Moroccan Room.
detail.notable: The Moroccan Room event space gets its own dedicated section with atmosphere-focused photography — a key revenue driver that needed to stand out from the main cafe experience.

name: Lions MMA
blurb: Full rebuild for one of Vancouver's most established MMA gyms.
mockupBlurb: one of Vancouver's most established MMA and combat sports gyms

detail.business: Lions MMA is a 25-year-old MMA gym in Vancouver, BC with a serious competition pedigree. Their old generic template site did nothing to reflect their history or convert new members.
detail.built: Full rebuild in Astro with React islands, Tailwind CSS v4, and Vercel. Warm near-black palette with brass accents, a filterable class schedule, 9 individual program pages, and a blog.
detail.notable: A signature tale-of-the-tape design motif runs throughout the site as a nod to the sport's tradition — giving the brand a distinctive visual identity no template could replicate.
